claims.subject: study
claims.attribute: number of languages investigated for PD speech classification
sentence_spans: The study under review investigates a transfer learning strategy for classifying Parkinson's disease (PD) from speech across three languages: Spanish, German, and Czech ([Document 1](document_1.txt)).

claims.subject: study
sentence_spans: The study uses three language-specific datasets: a Spanish dataset based on the PC-GITA corpus, a German dataset, and a Czech dataset ([Document 2](document_2.txt)).

claims.subject: transfer learning from Spanish to German
claims.condition: base model trained on Spanish utterances fine-tuned for German PD utterances
sentence_spans: The German dataset is also important in the transfer learning results because a model trained on Spanish utterances was used to fine-tune a model for classifying German PD utterances, yielding an accuracy improvement of up to 8% ([Document 1](document_1.txt)).

The transfer learning results indicate that the strategy improved accuracy by up to 8% when a base model trained with Spanish utterances was used to fine-tune a model for German PD utterances ([Document 1](document_1.txt)).
